facts.fact: The World Bank's project record for eGabon (P132824) shows a US$56 million IBRD loan approved on 3 June 2016, US$55.7 million of it disbursed, of which US$40.08 million plus US$1.50 million government counterpart was for strengthening the National Health Information System, designed to include electronic medical records and e-prescription; the record gives a closing date of 29 August 2025.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, ANINF and CNAM-GS as implementers; Ministry of the Digital Economy and CN-TIPPEE as implementing agencies of the loan
systems.tiers: not stated; the design provides for rural clinic data capture

note: A finance deal record: it states the loan and the component's design, not any deployment. The page itself warns that its implementing agency field is truncated.
